description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for seat selection in an event booking app. It manages UI for selecting seats, interacts with services to load seat data, and updates the shopping cart.

classes.name: SeatSelectionScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget allowing users to select seats for an event, displaying a grid of seat options and a button to add selected seats to the cart.

classes.name: _SeatSelectionScreenState
classes.description: State class managing seat selection logic, loading data from the EventService, and handling user interactions in SeatSelectionScreen.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads event and seat data from providers and services, updating the widget state.

methods.name: _toggle
methods.description: Toggles seat selection status, respecting reserved seats, and updates the UI accordingly.
